claude_proposed_widenings.name: subclass_grant
claude_proposed_widenings.justification: Subclass selection is a one-time character-progression gate with no activation cost, no resource, no rest reset, and no combat-relevant effect. The existing class_feature/activation family requires activationCost + resource + resetCadence + effect (grant_extra_action | heal_hp), none of which apply to 'you gain a subclass of your choice.'
claude_proposed_widenings.evidence: You gain a Sorcerer subclass of your choice. The Draconic Sorcery subclass is detailed after this class's description. A subclass is a specialization that grants you features at certain Sorcerer levels. For the rest of your career, you gain each of your subclass's features that are of your Sorcerer level or lower.
